verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair privacy-posture question for an online service that stores user data such as uploaded receipts and certificates, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any way for users to choose a storage region or residency. The docs cover filing, receipt upload, certificates and server status, but never where data is stored or any user control over it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
